title: Pollen packs have smaller bonuses
summary:
A day of clearer explanations: smaller Pollen pack bonuses, a rebuilt app-focused homepage, and tidier community docs.

Pollen pack grants were reduced: the $2 pack now gives 2 Pollen instead of 2.5, and the $100 pack gives 160 instead of 200, with reductions across the packs in between. Checkout now records the grant offered at purchase so a later catalog change cannot alter what the buyer receives.

The Hello homepage now explains the one-API approach to building AI apps, user-funded wallets, and optional developer earnings. A Dev kit replaces the old free-compute and tier sections; Latest and Next separate updates from plans. The Community page was also rewritten around builders and given a shorter subtitle.

The Pollen FAQ now explains app payments, free grants, wallet balances, and developer earnings more plainly, including that paid Pollen expires after 12 months of account inactivity. The README’s Recent Apps table now links several contributors to their GitHub profiles and drops an invalid app link.
